notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - Oculus
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29195540/54baa487467e56600f1f8dd9a50f042a087ab83c.png[/img]

Oculus Touch is officially supported!
Also don't forget to try Panic Mode if you want more of a challenge.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Oculus Touch Support
[*]Added controller laser for ease of interacting with computer/keypad
[*]Fixed issue with dropping crystals in maintenance drawers
[*]Fixed issue with panel slide puzzle
[*]Fixed room corners not blocking vision
[*]Increased note grab distance
[*]Adjusted red fuse position to reduce chance of dropping
[/list]

Thanks to red_star for testing Oculus Touch Support!
